title: After 16 Years, Cancelled Shonen Jump Revival Drops First Footage With New Trailer
content: One major Shonen Jump series is coming back with a brand new anime revival 16 years after it was cancelled, and now fans have gotten to see the first footage from the series with its first trailer.
author: ComicBook

title: K Manga Adds Daisaku Tsuru's Protocol Ryugu Manga
content: The manga began its Japanese serialization and launched on the Kodansha 's YanMaga Web website on Thursday. The manga was first featured in the special English issue of Kodansha 's Weekly Young Magazine that was published last year. The manga was one of the titles eligible for the readers' vote.
author: ANN

title: Manga Up! Global Adds Haimiya Is Scary Cute Manga
content: Manga UP! Global announced that it has released Sumu Kamiyama 's Haimiya Is Scary Cute ( Haimiya-senpai wa Kowakute Kawaii ) manga in English on Wednesday. The company describes the story: At my high school, everyone fears Haimiya-senpai.
author: ANN

title: Yoshitaka Amano's ZAN Limited Anime Series Debuts 1st Trailer at Anime Expo on July 3
content: Artist Yoshitaka Amano ( Vampire Hunter D , Final Fantasy ) announced on Wednesday that he has established the Los Angeles-based company Yoshitaka Amano Inc., which revealed that production has begun on ZAN , an anime based on his DEVA ZAN art.
author: ANN

title: Crunchyroll’s Biggest Isekai Confirms Release Date for Return With First Look Reveal
content: Crunchyroll ‘s biggest Isekai franchise has ended its first major arc this Spring, and it’s dropped the first look at its next major arc coming after a short hiatus. title: Attack on Titan Returns Before Major Studio MAPPA Event
content: Attack on Titan’s story has ended, with both the manga and the anime adaptation making no hints that Eren Jaeger and the Scout Regiment would be resurrected in the future. Despite Hajime Isayama sharing no hints that he would return to his beloved universe, the dark franchise is returning all the same.
author: ComicBook

title: Hana-Kimi Season 2 Unveils Key Visual, Episode 1 Preview
content: Hana-Kimi Season 2 unveiled a new key visual along with preview images for the upcoming Episode 1. The sequel is slated to premiere on July 1. The website of the anime describes the first episode of the second season as: The school festival has ended, and the usual daily life has returned to Osaka Academy.
author: Anime Corner
